Retry the outer aggregation waterfall on the new empty_merge_from_nonempty_input validation token.

commit_message:
Fail closed on empty aggregate output

Reject merged outputs with zero FINDING blocks when input findings existed, even if the empty-merge attestation token is present. Retry the outer aggregation waterfall on that validation token and update the aggregate harness plus SECURITY.md coverage.
